title: Create Blnbo Validator and Translator
description: Create/Refactor/Complete a validator and translator for blnbo (Berlin Building Code). Create a Go-based blnbo validator following the programming validator pattern. The validator reads translation JSON from stdin and outputs a report JSON to stdout. Rules include staircase-located (must be in separate stairwell) and building-height-limit (<21m). Also refine the translation subagent specification.
summary: Created blnbo (Berlin Building Code) Go validator and refined translation subagent. Validator reads translation JSON from stdin, validates staircase-located rule (§35 BauO Bln with 3 exemption clauses) and building-height-limit rule (§2 high-rise threshold 21m), outputs report JSON to stdout. All 16 tests pass. Updated coda.json target ID to ldrbmrtv.blnbo. Created blnbo.json config with translation schema and rule definitions.
